visual_style: Mobile MOBA, top-down isometric gameplay, stylized fantasy art

usage_notes.for_images: Use 'visual_description' as the primary prompt. Add 'lore_description' for character personality and backstory context.
usage_notes.for_videos: Use 'abilities' array for action sequences. Each ability includes visual effect descriptions for animation reference.
usage_notes.art_direction: Stylized mobile game aesthetic, vibrant colors, clear silhouettes, readable at small mobile screen scale

heroes.name: Halyx
heroes.lore_description: The youngest Master Assassin in his clan with extreme agility. Despite his youth, he has mastered the deadly arts of stealth, poison, and precision strikes, becoming a legendary backstab specialist feared across the realm.
heroes.visual_description: Muscular martial artist assassin with dark red-brown skin and fierce expression, sharp facial features and facial hair. Bare-chested showing defined muscles. Gray wrapped arm guards with red/brown accents. Long katana sword with wrapped brown handle. Dark gray pants with red horizontal stripes on legs. Heavy black boots. Intimidating aggressive stance. Youngest Master Assassin in his clan with extreme agility.

heroes.name: Ra-Keth
heroes.lore_description: Ancient Egyptian warrior who wields the power of spectral curses. Cursed by the pharaohs to serve as an eternal guardian, he uses mystical turquoise energy to curse his enemies and protect sacred grounds.
heroes.visual_description: Egyptian-inspired warrior with gray-blue Anubis-like features and pointed ears. Golden and black striped pharaoh headdress. Gold armor on shoulders and arms with ornate detailing. Prominent turquoise glowing gem in chest. Dual-wields curved khopesh swords with gold hilts. Dark purple and maroon garments with gold waist sash and arm bands. Muscular athletic build in combat stance.
heroes.combat_style: Melee fighter with magical curse abilities

heroes.name: Cravius
heroes.lore_description: Fierce orc berserker whose raw physical power is unmatched in close combat. His battle rage grows with each strike, unleashing devastating area attacks that can turn the tide of any battle.
heroes.visual_description: Massive orc warrior with bright green skin and fierce expression, prominent tusks and dark beard. Gray fur-trimmed armor on shoulders with dark metal plating. Wields huge double-bladed battle axe. Red war paint handprint on bare green chest. Brown leather straps and dark pants. Heavy armored boots. Intimidating brutish appearance with raw physical power. Dark gray/black hair tied back.

abilities.name: Mighty Cleave
abilities.visual_effect: Powerful axe swing with red energy that cleaves through multiple enemies

abilities.name: Tremor Strike
abilities.visual_effect: Ground-smashing axe attack creating yellow shockwave in directional path

abilities.name: Valorous Leap
abilities.visual_effect: Heroic jump attack with red/orange glow that pushes enemies and slows them

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.visual_effect: Spinning rage attack with bright blue/white cyclone energy, immune to crowd control

heroes.name: Drathos
heroes.lore_description: Born from The Burning Ember but chose the path of good. This demon warrior channels hellfire and demonic rage, growing stronger as his health drops. His redemption story drives him to protect the innocent despite his fearsome appearance.
heroes.visual_description: Demon warrior with red-orange skin, prominent curved black horns, pointed ears and fierce fanged grin. Dark gray spiked armor on shoulders with glowing orange-yellow lava cracks. Bare muscular chest and arms. Wields long bladed spear with red tip. White bandages wrapped around arms and waist. Dark pants and black boots. Demonic intimidating presence with hellfire aesthetic. Born from The Burning Ember but chose path of good.

abilities.name: Hell Scream
abilities.visual_effect: Demonic frenzy mode with red-orange flames, massive attack speed boost when health drops

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.visual_effect: Charging dash with golden-orange energy trail that stuns on hit

abilities.visual_effect: Throws enemies up and slams them down with bright yellow explosive impact

abilities.name: Blinding Rage
abilities.visual_effect: Unleashes hellish power with orange-red energy aura, gains movement speed and deals damage over time

heroes.name: Ruthon
heroes.lore_description: Ever the vanguard protector aiding allies while deterring enemies. This noble crusader radiates holy presence, using divine magic to heal companions and smite foes with sacred swords from the heavens.
heroes.visual_description: Noble knight crusader with tan skin and determined expression, brown hair. Shining royal blue and gold heavy plate armor with ornate detailing and blue diamond gems. Bright golden pauldrons with wing motifs. Wields glowing golden energy sword and blue shield with gold trim. Cape not visible but implied by armor design. Heroic stalwart defender stance radiating holy presence. Ever the vanguard protector aiding allies while deterring enemies.

heroes.name: Aranence
heroes.lore_description: Master of elemental magic who combines the fury of fire with the chill of ice. This wise elderly wizard has spent centuries perfecting the balance between opposing elements, making him a formidable distance control specialist.
heroes.visual_description: Wise elderly wizard with long white beard and stern expression. Dark navy blue hooded robe with orange/gold trim and ornate golden shoulder armor. Holds wooden staff with glowing golden orb at the top. Brown leather belt with gold buckle, carrying spell books and turquoise potion bottles. Dark pants and brown boots. Traditional fantasy wizard archetype with powerful presence.
heroes.combat_style: Ranged elemental mage, distance control specialist

heroes.name: Balec
heroes.lore_description: Dark arcane sorcerer who channels forbidden purple magic. With mysterious origins and a vertical scar of pure energy across his eye, he wields defensive dark magic that silences and punishes those who dare oppose him.
heroes.visual_description: Dark sorcerer with pale skin and intense purple eyes, vertical purple energy scar across right eye. Purple hooded robe with gold/yellow trim and ornate shoulder armor. Dark gray inner layers with leather belt holding spell components. Channels glowing purple orb of dark magic in right hand. Black pants and dark armored boots. Mysterious and intimidating presence with shadowy aesthetic.
heroes.combat_style: Dark magic mage, defensive caster with crowd control

heroes.name: Vio
heroes.lore_description: Daughter of nature who heals forests, rivers, and animals. Now she directly opposes those who harm nature, wielding poison and life magic to punish environmental destruction while healing the natural world and her allies.
heroes.visual_description: Nature goddess mage with bright pink-magenta hair in twin tails with yellow-green flower crown. Bright green eyes with cheerful expression. Green leafy dress-top with pink petal accents showing shoulders. Pink flowing skirt with green leaf details. Wields glowing yellow-green nature staff with leafy orb at top emitting bright green energy particles. Bare feet with green vine anklets. Daughter of nature who heals forests rivers and animals, now directly opposes those who harm nature.
heroes.combat_style: Support mage with poison and healing

heroes.name: Ilyana
heroes.lore_description: Craft and creative sharpshooter excelling at hunting with unmatched precision. This elven archer combines magical energy with her expert marksmanship to deliver devastating long-range attacks and explosive finishing shots.
heroes.visual_description: Elven archer huntress with pale lavender-gray skin and long white-blonde hair with golden crown headpiece. Pink-purple eyes with confident expression. Dark blue-gray feathered shoulder armor with gold accents. Dark navy sleeveless top showing arms. Wields elegant recurve bow with glowing golden-yellow energy arrow nocked. Purple-pink armored leg guards. Brown leather boots. Craft and creative sharpshooter excelling at hunting with unmatched precision.

heroes.name: Selara
heroes.lore_description: Silent vampire huntress who moves across the battlefield in single blinks with extreme mobility. She pierces enchanted armor leaving no mercy, using nightmare arrows to strike fear into the hearts of her enemies before vanishing into the shadows.
heroes.visual_description: Silent vampire huntress with pale lavender-gray skin and long flowing white-silver hair. Intense purple-pink eyes with determined expression. Dark burgundy red hooded cloak with high collar. Black and red tactical outfit underneath. Wields high-tech black and red crossbow with glowing energy mechanism. Black armored boots and leg guards. Moves across battlefield in single blink with extreme mobility. Pierces enchanted armor leaving no mercy.

abilities.visual_effect: Magical purple-cyan skull arrow with ghostly wisps that damages and inflicts fear on all enemies in line

heroes.name: Zaleth
heroes.lore_description: Notorious necromancer knowing no mercy or morality, violating life and innocence. Where death follows. This undead skeletal warrior summons the dead to fight alongside him while regenerating through dark magic.
heroes.visual_description: Undead skeletal necromancer with exposed skull face showing glowing eyes. Red tattered hooded cloak and scarf. Heavy golden-bronze ornate armor with black and gold striped pauldrons. Golden chain decorations across ribcage. Wields long metal scythe with curved blade glowing with red-pink necromantic energy. Dark gray-black leg armor with skull knee guards. Red cloth wrappings. Notorious necromancer knowing no mercy or morality violating life and innocence. Where death follows.
